title: Package gate: prove the installed dist/glyph.js reports the package version, not the 0.0.0 fallback
description: Low priority, not started. scripts/check-package.mjs runs every advertised command from the installed tarball but never --version, so no gate proves the bundled dist/glyph.js reads package.json (src/program.ts falls back to 0.0.0). From the Opus review of glyph-cli#99.

acceptanceCriteria.text: the gate runs glyph --version and glyph --json --version from the installed tarball under node and asserts the version equals the tarball package.json version (proof: gate output)
a mutation that makes the bundle read a missing package.json path turns the gate red (proof: recorded mutation run)
